description: Maximum sustainable yield, if estimated. Repeated each year like a reference point.
Spawning (mature) component. In mass units this is SSB; in count units it is spawner abundance.
Whole stock above any age cutoff given by `min_age`.
Component vulnerable to the fishery. Only include it if it is the main stock-size series (e.g. snow crab exploitable biomass, fishable shrimp biomass).
Survey or fishery index of stock size from the source given in `survey`. Only for assessments based on an index rather than a population model.
Lower status threshold for a component (e.g. a salmon CU lower benchmark).
Upper status threshold for a component (e.g. a salmon CU upper benchmark).
In 1/yr this is instantaneous fishing mortality (F), summarized by `type`; as a proportion it is a harvest rate: catch divided by the stock series given in `applies_to`.
Recruits at the age given in `age`.
Estimated recruitment deviations on the log scale, from the stock-recruit relationship or mean recruitment.
